issues.title: Explain data leakage in the glossary
issues.body:
## Goal

Add a definition of **data leakage** so beginners know why training and evaluation data must be separated.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Add one accurate, original definition to `src/data/glossary.js`.
- [ ] Use an example or phrasing a beginner can understand in 1–2 sentences.
- [ ] Ensure `npm run check` passes.

## Helpful starting point

Read existing entries first; avoid saying that every reuse of data is automatically leakage.

## For first-time contributors

issues.title: Introduce precision and recall in beginner-friendly terms
issues.body:
## Goal

Define **precision** and **recall** separately, avoiding unexplained mathematical jargon.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Add two distinct glossary entries to `src/data/glossary.js`.
- [ ] Distinguish false positives from false negatives correctly.
- [ ] Explain definitions clearly enough for a first-time ML learner.
- [ ] Run `npm run check`.

## Helpful starting point

Think of spam filters: precision asks whether flagged messages are actually spam; recall asks how much spam was found.

## For first-time contributors

1. Comment before starting so a mentor can assign the issue.
2. Make one focused change and open a pull request.
3. Link this issue, show what you tested, and explain your own work.
